capabilities: Split a paragraph into sentences or phrases with automatic or custom split marks
Reorder pieces by clicking, dragging, or number keys in a preview window
Group, indent, and convert pieces into notes, bullets, and headings before applying
Rewrite individual pieces or split out a selection while drafting
Reorganize sections and blocks of a whole page in a collapsible tree
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to rearrange sentences within a paragraph or restructure blocks of a note other than manually cutting and pasting text.
summary: Editing tool that splits a paragraph into sentences or phrases, lets you reorder them by click or drag, and reorganizes sections of a page in a tree.
